market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month settled ~$96.37 with intraday near $99-100. To hit $140 by end June requires ~40% further rally. Citi sees upside to $150 Brent (~$135 WTI) only in scenario of prolonged Hormuz closure; EIA peak forecast $115 Brent. ING expects flows to resume May-June. $140 WTI is a tail outcome.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Strait of Hormuz reopens or escalates further into a wider war
